ranked.headline: Pretrained protein encoders enable residue-level localization and chirality transfer
ranked.summary: Protein language model embeddings are now probed mechanistically and reused for residue-level binding and peptide design tasks.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models are extending spatial and single-cell transcriptomic inference
ranked.summary: Deep learning is now applied across spatial, single-cell and cell-free DNA transcriptomics, adding new supervision and imputation strategies.

ranked.headline: New methods infer genotypes, phasing, and population history from sequencing data
ranked.summary: Pooled, sparse, and hybrid long- and short-read datasets are driving demand for inference tools that scale in runtime and accuracy.

ranked.headline: Integrating molQTL, diverse-ancestry GWAS and causal inference to prioritize drug targets
ranked.summary: Combining xQTL, diverse-ancestry GWAS and causal inference now bridges noncoding variants to gene-level therapeutic target prioritization.

ranked.headline: Direct inference of pathogen resistance from reads and non-sequencing proxies
ranked.summary: End-user pipelines now detect resistance from raw nanopore and metagenomic reads, while MALDI-TOF spectra are tested as cheaper outbreak proxies.

ranked.headline: ML predicts CRISPR off-targets, enzyme promiscuity, and peptide cyclization outcomes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply ML to guide design across CRISPR, enzymes, peptides, and cryoprotectant formulations.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomics ties gene evolution and loss to lineage-specific traits
ranked.summary: Chromosome-level and near-chromosome-scale genomes across four taxa now allow lineage-resolved tests of gene content and trait-linked evolution.

ranked.headline: Fusing heterogeneous side information to predict drug-drug and drug-target interactions
ranked.summary: Recent 2026 preprints and publications couple textual, structural, and side-information modalities to predict drug interactions and synergy.

ranked.headline: Metrics and validation designs challenge claimed gains in single-cell prediction
ranked.summary: Simple baselines and linear pipelines often match foundation models, making evaluation design central to judging predictive claims.

ranked.headline: Symmetry-aware graph learning for molecular generation and property prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers couple group-symmetry handling with molecular graph generation and interpretable molecular property models.

ranked.headline: Genome-scale characterization of Leishmania, Plasmodium and alphavirus pathogens
ranked.summary: Chromosome-level assemblies from natural infections and in silico virion reconstruction extend pathogen genomics beyond reference isolates.

ranked.headline: Generative models conditioned on cryo-EM and cryo-ET density recover atomic structures
ranked.summary: Experimental density and tomographic data are now used as conditioning inputs for diffusion and autoencoder models of biomolecular structure.

ranked.headline: Statistical controls and long-read isoform methods reshape expression analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications address false positives, artifacts and isoform quantification across RNA-seq, scRNA-seq and ChIP-seq analyses.

ranked.headline: Physics-based models of protein complex assembly and nucleosome DNA unwrapping
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple mass spectrometry and crosslink data, learned protein representations, and coarse-grained simulations to molecular function.

ranked.headline: Learned models and free-energy workflows are accelerating biomolecular simulation
ranked.summary: Recent reports pair physics-grounded generative models and optimized workflows with runtime and scaling benchmarks across molecular problems.

ranked.headline: Read-level analyses resolve viruses, plasmid hosts, and CRISPR arrays in metagenomes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend read-level inference in shotgun metagenomes and metatranscriptomes to viruses, plasmid hosts, CRISPR arrays, and host sex.

ranked.headline: Machine learning models decode microbial genomes, enzymes, and microbiome features
ranked.summary: Recent work converts microbial sequences and taxonomies into compact features for phenotype, enzyme, and microbiome prediction.

ranked.headline: Computational frameworks link cell states, lineages, and aging in single-cell data
ranked.summary: Single-cell and time-series transcriptomes are now paired with formal models linking biomarkers, phenotypes, lineage history, and aging states.

ranked.headline: Simulations and designed proteins map energetic control of GPCR and channel function
ranked.summary: Enhanced-sampling MD, mechanistic kinase modeling and GPCR-directed design now resolve energetic and pharmacological determinants at receptor level.

ranked.headline: Faster exact and graph-based alignment and placement algorithms for genomic data
ranked.summary: Pangenome-scale datasets are pushing alignment, placement, and k-mer indexing toward sub-linear, cache-resident, and parallel designs.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools integrate biochemical and metagenomic data into interoperable resources
ranked.summary: Interoperable, machine-actionable frameworks are needed to join compound, bioprocess, and metagenomic datasets across heterogeneous source databases.

ranked.headline: Learned models infer circadian phase, EMT trajectories and gene expression dynamics
ranked.summary: Single-sample and spatial transcriptomic settings now demand validated predictors of internal state and temporal dynamics from molecular profiles.

ranked.headline: Energy and metabolic costs shape neural coding, plasticity, and transcriptomic scaling
ranked.summary: Explicit energy and metabolic accounting is now being built into both artificial and synaptic models of neural coding.

ranked.headline: Large cancer genome datasets assign mechanistic meaning to somatic alterations
ranked.summary: Cohorts of thousands of cancer genomes and cells now allow mutations, signatures and amplicons to be typed by mechanism, not only catalogued.

ranked.headline: Near-linear RNA folding extends to pseudoknots, chimeric evidence and codon design
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and published tools pair thermodynamic and learned models with faster RNA folding and coding-sequence design.

ranked.headline: Probabilistic and learned models drive MS identification and annotation workflows
ranked.summary: Narrow-window DIA, SLIM-based PAMAF, and 368 million MS/MS spectra now demand dedicated computational pipelines.

ranked.headline: Computational reconstruction of transposable element activity and genome architecture
ranked.summary: New methods estimate LINE-1 insertion ages, classify satellite repeat architecture, and annotate HERV LTR regulatory features genome-wide.

ranked.headline: Linking noncoding GWAS variants to target genes, splicing, and chromatin contacts
ranked.summary: Noncoding GWAS variants are being resolved to target genes, isoforms, and 3D contacts across brain, bone, and kidney tissues.

ranked.headline: New R and Python tools address batch effects and multi-omics integration
ranked.summary: Multi-omics and microbiome studies increasingly need reproducible tools for batch correction, longitudinal integration, and host-microbe testing.

ranked.headline: Learned models for brain MRI, iEEG and SEEG tied to anatomy and expert labels
ranked.summary: Automated pipelines and curated benchmarks now handle clinical neural data with expert-validated annotations and preserved pathology.

ranked.headline: Computational models link local cell rules to tissue-scale invasion and polarity
ranked.summary: Cellular Potts and gene circuit models now probe how mechanics, boundary cues and cell-type mixing drive tissue-scale behavior.

ranked.headline: Open in silico metabolite predictors benchmarked against human radiolabeled ADME data
ranked.summary: Predictive tools are now assessed against independent human ADME, clinical, and public resource data, with knowledge graphs as an integrating layer.

ranked.headline: LLM agents grounded in raw single-cell data for annotation and perturbation prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple LLM reasoning to explicit data and tools for scRNA-seq annotation, perturbation prediction and public metadata curation.

ranked.headline: Learned models predict infection potential, peptide retention, and cancer diagnosis
ranked.summary: Four February 2026 items apply pretrained, transfer, and sequence-learning models to clinical, proteomic, and microbial prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Pretrained foundation models span medical images, MEG signals, and molecular SMILES
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply pretraining and tokenization choices to medical imaging, MEG, BBB permeability, and molecular property prediction.

ranked.headline: Structured knowledge graphs and ontologies for standardized biomedical knowledge
ranked.summary: Recent preprints target variant representation, cell-type linking, and provenance-traced graph enrichment for biomedical knowledge bases.

ranked.headline: Structural and mutagenic genome diversity drives microbial phenotypic heterogeneity
ranked.summary: Long-read and theoretical frameworks now quantify how genome structure and diversification mechanisms generate microbial variation.

ranked.headline: Structure tools expose hidden conformations; zero-shot models fail under epistasis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints benchmark and extend structure-inference tools, exposing limits of zero-shot prediction and co-folding sensitivity to ligand input.

ranked.headline: Computational prioritization of candidates ahead of experimental testing
ranked.summary: Docking, learned models, and quantum descriptors are being used to narrow candidates before synthesis and assay.

ranked.headline: Automated extraction of cell dynamics from time-resolved microscopy images
ranked.summary: Recent software and deep-learning tools automate quantification of dynamics in live imaging of membranes, filopodia and deforming nervous systems.
